newsitem.title: USA: Eli Lilly, Lonza say to cooperate.
newsitem.headline: Eli Lilly, Lonza say to cooperate.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co and Lonza Biologics, a division of Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG, said they agreed to cooperate on developing and manufacturing an unspecified Lilly therapeutic protein that is in clinical trials.

Under the agreement, Lonza will manufacture and participate in the development of the product for Lilly, the companies said. Lonza will have undisclosed rights of first discussion for other proteins, and Lilly will license Lonza's proprietary GS Expression System for the production of proteins from mammalian cell culture, they said.
